title: DOSEFIELD: a transparent 1-D deep-space radiation dose and shielding model with source-traceable constants
description:
DOSEFIELD is a deterministic one-dimensional model of galactic cosmic-ray (GCR) dose. The Matthiä et al. (2013) GCR spectrum is transported in the continuous-slowing-down approximation (Bethe–Bloch stopping power with the Sternheimer density effect, effective charge for heavy ions, optional single-collision Bradt–Peters projectile fragmentation) through a shield of given areal density applied uniformly in every direction (spherical-shell geometry), and converted to absorbed dose and ICRP-60 dose equivalent at a point in water.

Secondary particles produced in the shield (secondary charged particles, target fragments, neutrons) are not transported. DOSEFIELD is not a substitute for full radiation-transport codes.

This release (tag paper1-v1.0.0) is the code version that reproduces every number in Paper 1 via scripts/reproduce_paper1.ts.
